oracles.claim: A signature produced by SLH-DSA Sign with a valid key and context shall verify under the matching public key.
limitations: Verification success is a functional relation, not a EUF-CMA security result

controls.positive_control: the signature is produced from a freshly generated key pair
controls.negative_control: a one-byte signature mutation is rejected by the negative oracle

oracles.claim: Two conforming SLH-DSA implementations exchanging public keys and signatures shall cross-verify for the same parameter set and context.
limitations: Cross-verification requires an identical hash family, pure/prehash mode, and context
A self-reference pair does not establish independent correctness

controls.negative_control: a signature from a different key does not verify

oracles.claim: A mutated SLH-DSA signature component (R, FORS, hypertree root, WOTS, or authentication path) shall not verify.
oracles.source_reference: FIPS 205 Sections 10.2 and 30.9-style component mutation requirements
limitations: Component-internal address-format and root-regeneration checks require component oracles
This oracle does not prove EUF-CMA

controls.negative_control: the mutation record shows the signature bytes changed

oracles.claim: A signature shall not verify for a message that differs from the signed message.
limitations: Message equality in the verifier domain is not tested across all message encodings

controls.negative_control: the mutation record shows the message bytes changed

oracles.claim: A signature shall not verify when the verification context differs from the signing context.
limitations: Adapters without context support return API_UNSUPPORTED and are not failures
Context boundary lengths 0/1/254/255/256 are not covered by this oracle

controls.negative_control: the mutation record shows the context bytes changed

oracles.claim: Hedged SLH-DSA signing shall consume the supplied opt_rand so that distinct randomness streams produce distinct signatures.
limitations: Deterministic profiles legitimately ignore ambient randomness
Reported RNG failure handling is a separate oracle

controls.positive_control: distinct deterministic tapes are observed to be consumed

oracles.claim: SLH-DSA verification shall return false for every signature length that differs from the parameter-set signature length.
oracles.source_reference: FIPS 205 Section 10.2; DeepSeek design doc Section 30.3
limitations: Truncations at R, FORS, and hypertree boundaries are sampled by separate component oracles
A wrapper that clamps the length records NOT_APPLICABLE

controls.negative_control: each boundary mutation record shows a changed signature length

oracles.claim: SLH-DSA context lengths 0, 1, 254, and 255 shall sign and verify, context length 256 shall be rejected, and a different verification context shall not verify.
oracles.source_reference: FIPS 205 Sections 10.2 and 11; DeepSeek design doc Section 30.7
limitations: Adapters without an extended-context boundary record NOT_APPLICABLE

controls.negative_control: a mismatched context does not verify

oracles.claim: SLH-DSA seed-based key generation shall produce the ACVP expected public and private keys from the declared seed components.
oracles.source_reference: FIPS 205 Sections 9.1 and 11; NIST ACVP SLH-DSA-keyGen-FIPS205 expectedResults
limitations: Requires a seed-keypair hook on the reference adapter

controls.positive_control: the same seed reproduces the same key pair
controls.negative_control: a different seed changes the key pair

oracles.claim: A pure SLH-DSA signature and a prehash SLH-DSA signature for the same message shall not verify in each other's domain.
oracles.source_reference: FIPS 205 Sections 10.2 and 11 and DeepSeek design doc Section 30.7
limitations: No prehash interface is exposed by the selected adapters; recorded NOT_APPLICABLE

controls.positive_control: a pure signature verifies in the pure domain
controls.negative_control: the record is not persisted as a finding

oracles.claim: Prehash SLH-DSA verification shall reject a digest whose OID or XOF output length differs from the signing parameters.
oracles.source_reference: FIPS 205 Sections 10.2 and 11 and DeepSeek design doc Section 30.7
limitations: No prehash/OID interface is exposed; recorded NOT_APPLICABLE

controls.positive_control: a matching prehash OID verifies when a prehash API exists
controls.negative_control: the record is not persisted as a finding

oracles.claim: A reported RNG failure during SLH-DSA key generation or signing should produce a failure indication and no signature output rather than proceeding with zeroed randomness.
oracles.source_reference: FIPS 205 Section 3.1 and DeepSeek design doc Sections 22 and 28.9
limitations: Void RNG APIs cannot report failure; continuing is a hardening gap

controls.positive_control: the same call succeeds without the injected failure
controls.negative_control: the failure tape is observed to be consumed
